gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with SHAM WAT ROAD and running generally in a south-easterly direction for about 290 metres where it bends to run in a north-easterly direction for about 140 metres; it then curves to run in a south-easterly direction for about 130 metres and then turns to run in a north-easterly direction for about 410 metres before it bends to run northerly for about 310 metres; it continues to run in a north-easterly direction for about 510 metres and then bends to run generally in an easterly direction for about 260 metres where it terminates at a roundabout near Po Lin Monastery as shown coloured pink on Plan No. ISRM 1.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與深屈道交界處起，向東南伸展約290米，後轉向東北伸展約140米，再轉向東南伸展約130米，後轉向東北伸展約410米，再轉向北面伸展約310米後，向東北伸展約510米，之後向東伸展約260米至寶蓮寺附近之迴旋處止。在 ISRM 1 號圖則上以粉紅色標明。
